storyBibleOverview.backfillConfirm:
{{count}} finalized chapters have no write-back in the story bible (no timeline, character state, or facts).

Re-extract them from the finalized text and their chapter notes? The text is not modified and no model call is made.
storyBibleOverview.backfillDone: Backfill done: {{chapters}} chapters written ({{events}} timeline entries, {{facts}} candidate facts); {{empty}} chapters had no usable notes.
storyBibleOverview.backfillNoResult: Nothing extractable in {{count}} chapters — usually because they have no chapter notes yet. Regenerate the notes on finalize, or add entries by hand.
storyBibleOverview.searchPlaceholder: Search characters, events, plots, or facts

memSearch.placeholder: Cross-search characters / events / items / foreshadowing / chapters…
memSearch.hint: Unified search: every hit shows why it matched, its source chapter, original-text evidence, validity, and conflict hints.
memSearch.empty: No matching memory found. Try other keywords, or confirm it was ever recorded — no fabricated answers.

storyBibleOverview.realmHint: Maintain a low-to-high ladder of cultivation realms (what each can do, what it cannot, and how to break through). It goes into the writing prompt so combat and breakthroughs obey the rules: crossing a realm requires conditions, breaking through requires paying a price.
storyBibleOverview.realmEmpty: No realm ladder yet. List only the tiers you actually use — no need to be exhaustive.
storyBibleOverview.locationHint: Record places with their distances and how people travel between them. It goes into the writing prompt so movement obeys the map: without a mount or a teleport, nobody walks from the frontier back to the sect.
storyBibleOverview.locationEmpty: No places recorded yet. List only the ones that recur — no need to draw a full map.
storyBibleOverview.locationTravel: How to get there / how long
storyBibleOverview.factPendingHint: This fact was extracted by AI and has not been reviewed by you
storyBibleOverview.itemLedgerEmpty: Nothing recorded yet. Once recorded, the writing prompt states who currently holds each item, so props do not appear or vanish out of nowhere.

draftGenerate.noOutline: No outline yet — generate one on the Plot rebuild tab first.
draftGenerate.generated: Done — edit or rewrite any segment.

pipeline.noOutline: No original outline yet — generate one under “Plot reconstruct” first.
pipeline.guidancePlaceholder: Overall guidance (optional), e.g. “slow the pace, more dialogue”
pipeline.instructionPlaceholder: Instruction for this run (optional) — used by rewrite / polish
pipeline.resumed: Restored the previous task; {{count}} segment(s) still unfinished.
pipeline.stalePlan: The outline changed, so this plan was built from the old one.
pipeline.replanned: Replanned: kept {{kept}} confirmed segment(s), {{reset}} need regenerating.
pipeline.statsLine: Chapter {{total}} chars · Han {{chinese}} · no spaces {{noSpace}} · no title {{noTitle}} · target {{target}}
pipeline.segmentPlaceholder: You can edit this segment by hand; generated text is only a candidate until you confirm it.
pipeline.precedingTruncated: Preceding text was long and got truncated by budget
pipeline.generated: Done — review or edit segment by segment.
pipeline.repetitionWarning: Segment {{sequence}} repeats {{length}} chars of the preceding text; consider rewriting it.
pipeline.acceptHint: Only the segment you accept is rewritten; other segments stay untouched.
pipeline.saved: Saved as draft version {{version}}; existing text was not overwritten.
pipeline.taskDiscarded: Pipeline task discarded (drafts and existing text are unaffected).

consistency.hint: "Awaiting review" means AI-extracted and not yet seen by you; "conflicts" contradict established canon. Confirm or reclassify under Story Bible → Key facts — extracted facts never enter canon automatically.
consistency.empty: No facts awaiting review or in conflict

similarity.hint: Local algorithms compare the new text against reference material and only flag things worth a second look: long identical runs, near-duplicate sentences, and beats matching reference events. The risk level is a hint, not a legal conclusion; shared genre conventions and common structures are not counted.
similarity.placeholder: Paste this chapter's text here (or reuse what Draft writing produced), then run the comparison.
similarity.needText: Paste the text you want to check first
similarity.statsLine: {{chapters}} reference chapters · {{chars}} chars compared · longest identical run {{run}} chars · near-duplicate sentences {{sentences}}

analysis.focusPlaceholder: Focus for this run (optional, e.g. conflict escalation and chapter-end hooks)
analysis.needSelection: Select at least one chapter first
analysis.cancelled: Stopped. {{done}} chapters done, {{failed}} failed — existing results are kept.
analysis.finished: Done: {{done}} chapters analyzed, {{skipped}} skipped (existing results are not re-billed).
analysis.finishedWithErrors: Finished: {{done}} succeeded, {{failed}} failed, {{skipped}} skipped. Failed chapters can be retried individually.
analysis.noChapters: This book has no chapters to analyze yet — import it under "Reference book" first.
analysis.sourceTruncated: Only the opening is shown here; open the chapter under "Reference book" for the full text.
analysis.noAnalysisHint: Start with "Analyze remaining chapters". Chapters are analyzed one by one; you can stop any time and resume later.
analysis.removeConfirm: Delete the analysis of chapter {{chapter}}? You will need to analyze it again.
